title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Transfer Size Bands by Openings or Door Units
content:
**Bands.** For a Warranty Coverage transfer, a size rate applies according to the number of window openings or door units on the contract the registration covers:

| Units on the covered contract | Size rate |
|---|---|
| at least 20 | 1.25 (large-home rate) |
| 6 to 19 | none |
| no more than 5 | 0.75 (small-home rate) |

In clause form: coverage of a contract with at least the large-home unit count of 20 window openings or door units takes the large-home rate; coverage of a contract with no more than the small-home unit count of 5 takes the small-home rate; coverage of any other contract takes no size rate.

## Where the count is read

| Registration covers | Count read |
|---|---|
| a window contract | the number of openings on its Window Replacement Contracts record |
| a door contract | the number of door units on its Entry & Patio Door Contracts record |

## Boundary cases

| Units | Band |
|---|---|
| 20 | large-home rate 1.25 |
| 19 | none |
| 6 | none |
| 5 | small-home rate 0.75 |
